agent_registration.entry_point: User (Joshua W. Dorsey, Sr.) request: add the prototype / not-medical-advice disclaimer to the already-published npm package @neurolift-technologies/rrt-advocate (currently 0.1.0) as a patch release (0.1.1), working in an isolated git worktree so the concurrently-building main checkout is not disturbed.
known_limitations: This is a safety-critical repo. Scope strictly limited to the publishable package's README.md banner and package.json metadata (description + keywords) plus a no-tag patch version bump (0.1.0 -> 0.1.1). No changes to src, dist, LICENSE, crisis-detection logic, thresholds, or CI/.github/workflows.
Worked entirely inside an isolated worktree (/tmp/nlt-wt-rrta) off origin/main; the main checkout was untouched because a separate process is building it.

Disclaimer is docs/metadata only — it does not change runtime behavior. The package remains a prototype with stubbed intervention layers; banner makes that explicit and points users to 988/911/findahelpline.com.
agent_registration.preferred_handoff_format: JSON handoff record per OTOI Section 5
